name: Taipei
disclaimer: Demo-grade, simplified rules. Not legal advice. Always confirm with the responsible office.

permits.name: Business registration
permits.agency: Department of Economic Development, Commerce Office
permits.agencyLocal: 臺北市政府產業發展局 商業處
permits.appliesWhen: Opening any shop, café, restaurant, studio or other for-profit business.
documents: Proof of right to use the premises (lease or ownership)
Business name and scope of business

permits.name: Change of building use permit
permits.agency: Department of Urban Development, Construction Management Office
permits.agencyLocal: 臺北市政府都市發展局 建築管理工程處
permits.appliesWhen: Using a space for a different purpose than its registered use, e.g. turning a residential unit into a café, restaurant, shop or classroom.
documents: Building use permit (使用執照) copy

permits.name: Interior renovation review permit
permits.agency: Department of Urban Development, Construction Management Office
permits.agencyLocal: 臺北市政府都市發展局 建築管理工程處
permits.appliesWhen: Changing partitions, ceilings or fixed fittings in a building used by the public, or in residential buildings of 6+ floors.
documents: Renovation drawings by a licensed professional

permits.name: Food business registration
permits.appliesWhen: Preparing, selling or serving food or drinks to the public.

permits.name: Fire safety equipment review and inspection
permits.nameLocal: 消防安全設備審查及查驗
permits.appliesWhen: Change of use, renovation, or opening a venue where the public gathers (cafés, restaurants, classrooms).

permits.name: Signboard / outdoor advertisement permit
permits.agency: Department of Urban Development, Construction Management Office
permits.agencyLocal: 臺北市政府都市發展局 建築管理工程處
permits.appliesWhen: Installing a large, protruding, illuminated or LED sign on a building facade or rooftop.
documents: Sign design drawing with size and position

permits.name: Short-term tutoring school registration
permits.appliesWhen: Teaching groups of students for a fee on a regular basis (language, academic or arts classes).
documents: Floor plan with classroom area per student
Fire safety and building use compliance

zoningNotes: Residential zones (住宅區, 住一 to 住四) restrict commercial use. Restaurants and cafés are usually limited by floor area and floor level, and are easiest on the ground floor.
Rooftop additions (頂樓加蓋) without a permit are illegal structures (違章建築) and can be reported and demolished.
Older walk-up apartments often lack the fire exits or ventilation that a change to commercial use requires.
Signs on main roads must fit the facade and must not block fire escape routes or windows.
